components.description: Visible label, pale field, and attached yellow search action.
components.css: .ds-search-label{display:block;font:600 14px Oswald,sans-serif;margin-bottom:8px;color:var(--ink,#221f19);}.ds-search{display:flex;border:2px solid var(--ink,#221f19);background:var(--field,#fff8e8);}.ds-search input{border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--ink,#221f19);padding:10px 12px;min-width:0;width:100%;font:12px ui-monospace,monospace;min-height:44px;}.ds-search button{border:0;border-left:2px solid var(--ink,#221f19);background:var(--yellow,#f6cc18);color:var(--ink,#221f19);width:46px;flex-shrink:0;display:grid;place-items:center;cursor:pointer;}.ds-search button:hover{color:var(--ink,#221f19);}.ds-search button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus,#056b9b);outline-offset:4px}.ds-search input:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus,#056b9b);outline-offset:4px}

components.name: Open catalog card
components.description: Bordered complete artwork, unboxed reading detail, and ruled purchase row.
components.css: .ds-card{max-width:290px;background:transparent;color:var(--ink,#221f19);border:0;border-radius:0;box-shadow:none;}.ds-art{display:block;aspect-ratio:3/4;overflow:hidden;border:2px solid var(--ink,#221f19);background:#342c23;}.ds-art img{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain;padding:12px;box-sizing:border-box;transition:transform .2s ease-out;}.ds-art:hover img{transform:scale(1.035);}.ds-card h3{font:600 24px/1.15 Oswald,sans-serif;margin:13px 0 0;}.ds-card a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none;}.ds-card p{font:12px/1.55 ui-monospace,monospace;margin:10px 0 14px;}.ds-price{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;border-top:1px solid #221f1970;padding-top:12px;}.ds-price strong{font:600 21px Oswald,sans-serif;}.ds-price button{background:var(--yellow,#f6cc18);color:var(--ink,#221f19);border:2px solid var(--ink,#221f19);padding:9px 10px;min-height:44px;font:600 15px Oswald,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;}.ds-price button:hover{color:var(--ink,#221f19);}.ds-price button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus,#056b9b);outline-offset:4px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-art img{transition:none;}}.ds-card a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus,#056b9b);outline-offset:4px}

narrative.overview:
A tactile storefront drawn from the user's Thunder & Pulp reference: warm paper, yellow title panels, scarlet strips, and heavy ink rules frame a real published comic cover against a generated bookstore photograph. The mood is energetic and collectible, with the buying action given the same visual confidence as the artwork.
This isolated demonstration uses Spanish copy and sample BOB prices. Prices, stock, and the three-comic collection are local demonstration data; checkout creates no order and charges nothing. Preserve that disclosure without repeated labels crowding the title.
keyCharacteristics: Bold comic display type, condensed navigation, and compact monospaced descriptions.
Square panels separated by printed ink rules.
Warm photographic depth and restrained raster print grain.
A large yellow buying action inside an ink purchase panel.

rules.name: Legible Ink
rules.body: Keep purchase text in paper against ink and the main action in ink against yellow. Keep checkout explanatory copy dark and fully opaque.

rules.name: Three Voices
rules.body: Reserve Bangers for the masthead, featured heading, and hero action; keep Oswald for hierarchy and mono for reading detail.

dos: **Do** keep the buying action visually dominant and its current sample price visible.
**Do** preserve published cover proportions and maintain the existing art credits.
**Do** use heavy ink rules and square controls to hold the printed composition together.
**Do** retain selection semantics, keyboard focus, result feedback, and readable checkout notes.
**Do** make the no-charge demo status clear in practical copy.
donts: **Don't** replace the three type roles with one condensed font everywhere.
**Don't** turn catalog items into rounded, shadowed cards or nest unnecessary panels around their copy.
**Don't** repeat the same product label above and inside the featured title.
**Don't** treat generated shop imagery, sample stock, or local checkout as a real shop or completed sale.
**Don't** place print grain over form entry surfaces or reduce the checkout note's contrast.
